title: Add ReadPosition cross-reference note to RFC 8621 $seen
description: The ReadPosition section should include a brief note explaining that it serves the same local read-tracking purpose as the $seen keyword in RFC 8621 (JMAP Mail), but uses a cursor model (lastReadMessageId) rather than per-message boolean flags. Rationale: chat is an ordered stream where the client reads up to a point; per-message flags would be O(n) per chat open and semantically wrong. Useful for implementors coming from JMAP Mail. One sentence in the ReadPosition section of draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.
close_reason: Added RFC 8621 $seen cross-reference sentence to ReadPosition intro paragraph (chat-00.md:749)
